summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the new reviewer profile feature (/api/reviewer/:slug, follow/unfollow) and bidirectional navigation. 8/8 pytest cases pass (Ananya aggregation across 2 businesses with correct bio/social/follower_count=342/avg_rating=4.0/member_since; Shweta with no seeded profile returns 200 with defaults; Rohit's seeded bio+instagram; 404 for nonexistent slug; follow increments and unfollow decrements; unfollow never negative for 0-count reviewer; business page regressions OK). Playwright verified /profile/ananya-iyer renders header (name, 'Product Manager, Fintrail' title, bio, Instagram+LinkedIn links, Verified reviewer pill), 4 metric cards (2 reviews / 4★ / referrals / member since Jun 13 2026), business chips (The Solved Skin + AI Fiesta), and exactly 2 review cards. Follow button toggles Follow<->Following with optimistic count 342->343->342. Business chip navigates to /business/ai-fiesta. Reviewer-link on ai-fiesta navigates to /profile/:slug. Review card on profile navigates to /business/ai-fiesta#reviews. /profile/nonexistent-slug shows not-found. /profile/shweta renders with defaults (0 followers, no bio element).
critical_code_review_comments: Follow persistence uses localStorage keyed by reviewer_slug — not tied to a user account, so 'Following' state won't sync across devices. Acceptable for MVP but worth noting.

Concurrent follows can race since follow uses $inc but unfollow reads-then-$set (max(0, current-1)); two simultaneous unfollows could over-decrement. Consider using $inc with a subsequent bounded update or aggregation pipeline update for atomic clamp.

TEST_-prefixed reviewer slugs from earlier iteration tests (e.g. test_qa-bot) now show up on ai-fiesta reviewer links — cosmetic pollution of seeded data. Not a functional bug, but consider filtering TEST_ prefix in the reviews list endpoint or scrubbing before next release.
seed_data_creation: None new. Follow/unfollow tests are self-cleaning (follow+unfollow leaves counts equal). Shweta profile is upserted by follow tests but count remains 0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_reviewer_profile.py at /app/backend/tests/ covers GET/POST reviewer endpoints + basic business regression. Note: leftover TEST_ reviewers (test_qa-bot, test_ui-bot) from iteration_2 still exist in ai-fiesta reviews collection. ReviewerPage uses localStorage key uplaud_follow_{slug} for follow state. Follow endpoint uses $inc atomic; unfollow uses read-then-$set clamp at 0.
